scripts.build:conformance-apps: loutre build fixtures/http-crud/src/app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/http-crud && loutre build fixtures/streaming/src/http-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-http && loutre build fixtures/streaming/src/message-port-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-message-port
scripts.test:deno: npm run build:conformance-apps && deno run -A conformance/deno.ts
scripts.test:bun: npm run build:conformance-apps && bun run conformance/bun.ts
scripts.test:lambda: npm run build:conformance-apps && npx --yes --package node@24.19.0 node conformance/lambda.mjs
scripts.test:node: node -e "if (!process.version.startsWith('v26.')) process.exit(1); console.log('Node.js 26 conformance: 成功')" && vitest run tests/http-crud.e2e.test.ts tests/http-stream.fixture.test.ts tests/runtime-conformance.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: npm run test:node && npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:workerd && npm run test:electron && npm run test:lambda && npm run test:cli-start && npm run test:cli-dev
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:types && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:conformance
